history.title: Preview both hoodies on the existing London character

input.prompt: Edit the existing original PS2 game-style London male character into a two-panel garment approval sheet. Two equal vertical 9:16 panels side by side, NO white gutters, NO text or labels. Reference 1 is the ORIGINAL CHARACTER and exact penthouse camera, sunset London skyline with Shard, leather chair and floor lamp. Preserve his exact original low-poly adult face, blond braids, skin, expression, pose seated with crossed leg, grey jeans, white sneakers, camera, scene and PS2 video game style. Reference 2 is Disobedient's real Low Lives Hoodie FRONT: light heather grey PULLOVER with kangaroo pocket and NO zipper, NO drawcord, NO chest logo. LEFT panel: replace only the source blue hoodie with that exact grey pullover, correct fleece shape and no invented marks. Reference 3 is VYLIN real garment front on a real model: use ONLY the garment, NEVER the model face/body/identity. RIGHT panel: same original London character wearing the black ZIP hoodie with silver zipper and small cream oval globe/stylized leaf logo on character's left chest, as in reference. Do not add the large rear headphones print to the chest. Both panels keep original character identity completely unchanged and the SAME original room geometry. Garment seams, cuffs, collar and natural occlusion by hands must be plausible and match the product source. Front-facing camera cannot show rear garment graphics, so do not invent them. No new persons, no slogans, no UI, no end card, no captions, no white product-photo background. These are original ImageGen preproduction concept STILL images, not actual Genjutsu video results.

history.title: Fetch the real Genjutsu pricing rule

quote.pricing_description: Priced per total second by resolution: 480p $0.05, 720p $0.10, or 1080p $0.20. Rates shown are before any applicable customer discount. Billable seconds = output duration + the sum of input reference video durations. Input video durations are measured during preprocessing; without video references, only output duration is billed. Genjutsu Light trims the source to 15 seconds; output duration is rounded up to whole seconds before billing.
